description: This file defines the TinyMCE preview plugin, including functions to generate the HTML for preview controls, handle preview commands, and embed media objects within the preview window.

methods.name: getInfo()
methods.description: Returns metadata about the plugin, such as name, author, version, and URLs.

methods.name: getControlHTML(cn)
methods.description: Returns the HTML for the preview control button.

methods.name: execCommand(editor_id, element, command, user_interface, value)
methods.description: Handles the execution of the preview command, opening the preview window either in a new window or an embedded iframe.

methods.name: _setDoc
methods.description: Stores the document object of the preview window and initializes embed array.

methods.name: _setWin
methods.description: Stores the window object of the preview window.

methods.name: _onLoad
methods.description: Handles the preview window's load event, replacing placeholder embed codes with actual media objects.

methods.name: _writeFlash
methods.description: Embed Flash content in the preview.

methods.name: _writeShockWave
methods.description: Embed ShockWave content in the preview.

methods.name: _writeQuickTime
methods.description: Embed QuickTime content in the preview.

methods.name: _writeRealMedia
methods.description: Embed RealMedia content in the preview.

methods.name: _writeWindowsMedia
methods.description: Embed Windows Media content in the preview.

methods.name: _writeEmbed
methods.description: Generates the HTML markup for embedding media content.
